capabilities: Add an Auto row height option to Bases table views
Size each row to its tallest cell and wrap long text
Keep clicks, selection, arrow keys and PageUp/PageDown on the visible row
Grow rows when late content such as images renders
Cap large tables with a maxRows setting
extras: Ships a demo vault that can be opened with a command, downloaded as a zip from releases, or read on GitHub; beta builds install through BRAT.
intentEvidence: Adds an Auto row height to Bases table views, so each row grows to fit its content
problem: Bases tables give every row one fixed height, so Short cuts long values off mid-sentence and Tall wastes space on short rows.

relations.evidence: Same goal as: it wraps within the fixed Medium, Tall or Extra tall height
Same goal as: a replacement view; this plugin keeps the core table view

summary: Adds an Auto row height option to Bases table views so each row grows to fit its tallest cell and wraps long text.
